title: Sex Discrimination Amendment (Restoring Biological Definitions) Bill 2025
short_title: Sex Discrimination Amendment (Restoring Biological Definitions) Bill 2025

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would remove gender identity discrimination provisions from the Sex Discrimination Act 1984 and introduce definitions of men and women based on sex.
It would define men as members of the male sex and women as members of the female sex, with both definitions applying regardless of age.
The amendments would remove gender identity references across the listed provisions of the Act and take effect on the day following Royal Assent.
changes: The statutory definition of gender identity would be deleted.
Section 5B would be repealed, with associated references removed from other provisions.
Several provisions, including the sexual orientation definition, would refer to the opposite sex instead of a different sex.
summary.affected: People covered by gender identity discrimination provisions, and men and women as defined in the bill, are affected.

divisions.question: Sex Discrimination Amendment (Restoring Biological Definitions) Bill 2025 - First Reading - Let the bill be considered in Parliament
